brief: AI-powered career OS — resumes, mock interviews, job tracking, portfolios, GitHub intelligence and outreach in one free, open-source workspace. The mark should feel like a co-pilot: confident, forward-moving, guiding.
criteria: Success: ownable in a noisy career-tools category, reads at 16 px, works in one colour, encodes 'pilot' structurally rather than literally.

concepts.name: Captain Wing
concepts.idea: Four pilot epaulette rank stripes swept into a wing — captain, and climbing.
rationale: Encodes 'pilot' structurally — rank stripes, not a literal plane
Doubles as a rising bar chart: career growth, step by step
Strongest 16 px survival of all ten tested concepts (89–99/100 audit range)
Nothing in the resume-tools category owns four swept stripes

recommendation: Captain Wing — the only direction where 'pilot' is built into the structure, with growth built into the shape.
next_steps: Ship the web icon set (done — see exports/)
